title: Autumn Trio
description:
Three steps, one youthful glow: a little kit to help your skin ease into autumn and winter feeling calm, comforted, and renewed.

Super-R (7 capsules)

title: Micro Exfoliating Balm
description:
Multi-award winning exfoliating balm formulated to buff away tired skin cells and impurities using the micro silica and MSM particles, but also nourish the lipid barrier to leave your skin soft, radiant and glowing.
Enriched with a blend of youth-boosting essential cell nutrients, prebiotics and peptides for long lasting skin health. The rich balm becomes a soft, light milk in contact with water. It can also be adapted to become as strong or gentle as you desire, just by adding water.

title: Adaptive Tan Mist
description:
Multi-Award winning
A super-fine natural self-tanning mist for face and body, with a unique Tri-Phase technology. Mist directly onto skin without rubbing in for a streak-free, natural-looking tan that builds gradually and conditions as it develops.
Phase 1: Instant Tan.
 Surface DHA provides a healthy glow within 3 to 4 hours.
Phase 2: Melanin Boost.
 Our Melanin Complex with Monk's Pepper, Tyrosine and Arginine stimulates your skin's own melanin production for a natural, protective tan that develops from within.
Phase 3: Deep Tan.
 Naturally micro-encapsulated DHA penetrates deeper layers for a longer-lasting, more even result.
MSM, Pea Peptides and a blend of conditioning actives treat the skin throughout. Works on face and body. No patchy results, no streaks, no rub-in required.

45% improvement in lines and wrinkles in 8 weeks

 Formulated for skin over 40, or with visible signs of premature ageing.

title: Super-R Retinoid Capsules 0.5% HRP
description:
A super charged evening retinoid serum treatment containing OSKIA’s advanced Super-Nutrient Retinoid Complex (with
 0.5% Hydroxypinacolone Retinoate HPR, Vitamins C, E & Pro-Vitamin D3)

HPR is a fantastic retinoid with excellent skin regenerating and clearing properties but without the sensitivities associated with using retinol and retinoids, making it ideal for even more sensitive skin.
Our capsules are made from seaweed, are biodegradable and compostable.
The best retinoid for sensitive skins.

title: Super C Beauty Capsules
description:
Winner of 10 Best Vitamin C Awards
No oxidation, no acidity, no sensitivity, just beautifully preserved Vitamin C for brighter, firmer skin.
A super-charged blend of Vitamin C and Smart Vitamin E to boost skin health, protect, brighten, plump and nourish for youthfully radiant, brighter skin. Our biodegradable capsules (made of seaweed) perfectly preserve the Super-C oil serum and are ideal single-use, travel-friendly doses for a daily skin super-charge.
We believe that in the case of Vitamin C, little and often is better. Vitamin C is notoriously unstable and can easily become pro-oxidant if used at high levels, causing cellular damage. OSKIA’s superior form of stable Vitamin C and Smart Vitamin E work synergistically to provide enhanced results at safer, lower levels.

Clinically-proven to increase skin hydration by up to 34% after 1 hour and 30% after 4 weeks*.
In addition to boosting cellular hydration and plumping to quench thirsty skin, this serum also offers anti-inflammatories to calm, replenishes vital nutrients and moisture reserves, and contains ceramides to strengthen the skin’s barrier function to reduce trans epidural water loss.

Award-winning pure organic rose water toner with MSM, Panthenol and Black Carrot that hydrates, calms and softens all skin types.
A mild Rosa Damascena Flower Water, hand-harvested and steam-distilled to preserve the delicate actives and natural scent that commercial extraction destroys. We hand-harvest to prevent petal bruising, which degrades both the perfume and the beneficial compounds in the hydrolat.
MSM (methylsulfonylmethane), OSKIA's founding ingredient, calms inflammation, supports the skin barrier and aids absorption of the other actives. Panthenol (Provitamin B5) hydrates and soothes. Hibiscus extract, rich in AHAs including malic and citric acid, provides gentle exfoliation and promotes a more even skin texture. Black Carrot Juice delivers carotenoid antioxidants that protect against free radical damage.
Suitable for all skin types. Use morning and evening after cleansing. Splash onto the face or apply with a cotton pad.
Beauty Bible 2023: Gold Award, Best Natural Toner. Silver Award, Best Toner.
